[[File:Tanning_interface.png|frame|The Tanning Interface]]
A '''tanner''' is a [[non-player character]] who, for a price, will tan unnoted hides into leather:

*[[Cowhide]], which becomes [[leather]] or [[hard leather]]
*[[Snake hide]], which becomes [[snakeskin]].
*Green, blue, red, and black [[dragonhide]], which becomes [[dragon leather]] of the same colour.

==Leathers==
Players can also tan hides themselves with the [[Lunar spells|Lunar spell]] [[Tan Leather]], which requires 78 [[Magic]] and the [[Fremennik Diary#Hard|Fremennik Hard Diaries]], without paying any coins. The cost of the spell whilst wearing a source of infinite fire runes (such as a [[Staff of fire]] or a [[Tome of fire|Tome of fire)]]) is {{NoCoins|{{#vardefineecho:costpercast|{{#expr:{{GEP|Astral rune|2}}+{{GEP|Nature rune|1}}}}}}|c}}, tanning up to 5 hides at once.

==Trivia==
* In the early days of ''RuneScape'', there were plans to allow players to tan their leather themselves using the {{RSCL|tailoring|tailoring skill}}. This never came to fruition and instead the concept was merged into the [[Crafting]] skill.
